purpose: Teach: 悪役/手記/品格/ドラフト/政教/采配/踏襲/俯瞰

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界で悪役にされないよう、CSR、強化しろ。
lines.en: Make sure we don't become the villain in this industry. Strengthen our CSR efforts.
lines.style: Measured, expectant. Leans forward slightly on the directive. Crisp consonants. The tone of someone used to being listened to, not checking for agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の手記、社内、共有しました。
lines.en: Understood. I've already shared the founder's memoir with the team internally.
lines.style: Steady, efficient. No flourish. Simple acknowledgment with evidence of forward momentum. Even breath, professional clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 品格ある経営、若手にも示せ。
lines.en: Show the younger staff what dignified management looks like. Embody it.
lines.style: Firm instruction, not harsh. Weight on 'dignified.' Slight pause after — lets it land. Expects execution, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新企画のドラフト、明日提出します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the draft for the new initiative ready by tomorrow.
lines.style: Brisk, confident nod in the voice. No apology, no hedging. The cadence of someone who keeps promises and knows the boss knows it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 政教分離、CSR方針として、明確に。
lines.en: Be explicit about the separation of politics and religion in our CSR policy. No grey area.
lines.style: Slightly sharper attack. The word 'explicit' lands with intention. Controlled, leaving no room for misinterpretation. Still measured — not angry, just clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営者の采配、社員からも信頼されています。
lines.en: Yes. The team trusts your judgment on these decisions. That confidence matters.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formality. Small recognition of the boss's influence. Steady voice, genuine — not flattery, observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 伝統を踏襲しつつ、革新も忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't lose sight of innovation while we honour our traditions. Both matter.
lines.style: Balanced, reflective. Slight emphasis on 'both.' The cadence of wisdom offered, not lecturing. A moment of pause — the boss thinking out loud but decisively.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場全体を俯瞰して、戦略を立てます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll map out the broader market landscape and build strategy from that vantage point.
lines.style: Alert, engaged. The closing line — a little more resonance, showing he's absorbed the bigger picture. Confident but not presumptuous. Settles with finality.
